He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the best [[small forward]]s in the 2021 class. ==High school career== As a sophomore at [[East Ridge High School (Minnesota)|East Ridge High School]] in [[Woodbury, Minnesota]], Brown averaged 17.6 points and led the team to its first state tournament appearance. After the season, he transferred to Sunrise Christian Academy in [[Bel Aire, Kansas]].{{cite web |last1=Paulsen |first1=Jim |title=Kendall Brown leaving East Ridge for prep school in Kansas |url=https://www.startribune.com/kendall-brown-leaving-east-ridge-for-prep-school-in-kansas/512798892/ |website=[[Star Tribune]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=July 21, 2019}} Brown was teammates with top recruit [[Kennedy Chandler]]. As a senior, he helped his team reach the [[GEICO]] Nationals title game.{{cite web |last1=Eldridge |first1=Taylor |title=‘The little engine that could’: Sunrise proves it belongs with national hoops powers |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/varsity-kansas/varsity-basketball/article250414321.html |website=[[The Wichita Eagle]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=April 3, 2021}} He was named to the [[2021 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], [[Jordan Brand Classic]] and [[Nike Hoop Summit]] rosters.{{cite web |last1=Fuller |first1=Marcus |title=Five-star homegrown hoops talent Kendall Brown on young athletes giving back: "We have to use the platform we have." |url=https://www.startribune.com/five-star-homegrown-hoops-talent-kendall-brown-on-young-athletes-giving-back-we-have-to-use-the-platform-we-have/571130782/ |website=[[Star Tribune]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=June 9, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=James |first1=Ryan |title=Kendall Brown had a 5-Star Season at Sunrise Christian |url=https://247sports.com/college/minnesota/LongFormArticle/Minnesota-Basketball-Recruiting-5-Star-Kendall-Brown-had-a-5-Star-Season-at-Sunrise-Christian-146836944/ |website=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=May 5, 2020}} ===Recruiting=== Brown was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the best [[small forward]]s in the 2021 class. On July 20, 2020, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]] over offers from [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] and [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]], among others.{{cite web |last1=Bedore |first1=Gary |title=Kendall Brown, No. 12-ranked player in Class of 2021, picks Baylor over KU, others |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article244352267.html |website=[[The Kansas City Star]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=July 20, 2020}} Brown is the highest-ranked recruit to come to Baylor since [[Isaiah Austin]] in 2012.{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |last2=Biancardi |first2=Paul |title=5-star player Brown of Kansas commits to Baylor |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29503107/5-star-player-kendall-brown-kansas-commits-baylor |website=ESPN.com |language=en |date=July 20, 2020}} He said that since he came from a Christian high school, he liked the fact that Baylor was a Christian university.{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=Elite 2021 Wing Kendall Brown Commits to Baylor season, Brown was voted Preseason [[Big 12 Conference]] Freshman of the Year.{{cite web|title=Big 12 Unveils 2021-22 Men’s Basketball Preseason points in a 87–60 victory over [[Incarnate Word Cardinals men's basketball|Incarnate Word]]. He earned [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Newcomer of the Week honors twice (12/20, 3/7).{{cite web|title=MBB Pair Pick up Big 12 Weekly Awards|url=https://baylorbears.com/news/2022/3/7/mens-basketball-mbb-pair-pick-up-big-12-weekly-awards.aspx|date=March 7, 2022|accessdate=March 30, 2022}} As a freshman, Brown averaged 9.7 points and 4.9 rebounds per game. At the end of the season, he was named to the [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] All-Freshman Team.{{cite web|title=Men's Basketball All-Big 12 Awards
